If you have a nosebleed, the recommended action is to lean forward and breathe through your mouth. This position helps prevent blood from running down the back of your throat, which can cause choking or vomiting. Tilting your head back (Option A) is not advised because it can cause blood to flow down your throat. Lying down (Option C) is also not recommended because it can increase blood pressure in the head and worsen the bleeding.

Answer: B
